t: Bosch Professional GBA 18V 5.0Ah CoolPack battery provides long, stable runtime for demanding trade tasks. Its higher-capacity design delivers extended operation compared with 4.0Ah units, while CoolPack technology improves heat control to support a longer service life for extended periods under regular site use. The robust housing remains functional after a 3-metre drop. Compatible with all tools and chargers within the Bosch Professional 12V system and AMPShare Alliance, providing a consistent, site-ready power solution.
b: Compatible with Bosch Professional 18V System & AMPShare Alliance
